title: Mediumcore Enhanced+
description: A vanilla experience that enhances quality of life while introducing a tougher, more unforgiving challenge, between normal survival and hardcore intensity.
body:
# Mediumcore Vanilla+

Mediumcore Vanilla+ is a **Fabric modpack** that enhances the vanilla Minecraft experience while staying true to its core identity. It introduces **quality-of-life improvements**, **visual and audio upgrades**, **performance optimizations**, and a carefully designed **increase in difficulty**.

![Mediumcore Vanilla+](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50d1177e17c095b697a47f4e1fdad50d63c61ae2.jpeg)

## Mediumcore Survival

The heart of the modpack is its **mediumcore difficulty**, sitting between normal survival and hardcore mode.

- Upon death, you respawn at a **random location** in the world
- You lose your sense of direction and must find your way back
- Every death becomes a meaningful setback - not the end, but never trivial

This system creates tension, risk, and memorable survival moments without permanently locking you out of your world.
\
\
\
'_Don’t die… or be ready to get lost._'

## Exploration & Immersion

To deepen immersion, navigation is no longer effortless:

- Coordinates are disabled by default
- Craft a Logbook to manually record important locations
- Rely on memory, landmarks, and preparation to navigate the world

Getting lost is part of the experience—and finding your way back is the reward.

## Vanilla+ Enhancements

The modpack improves the base game without changing its identity:

- Subtle quality-of-life improvements
- Enhanced graphics and sound design
- Carefully selected features that feel like they belong in vanilla

Everything is designed to feel natural and cohesive.

## Performance & Optimization

Mediumcore Vanilla+ is built to run smoothly:

- Performance-focused mods to increase FPS and stability
- Optimized visuals without unnecessary overhead
- A smoother experience on a wide range of systems

## Play Your Way

Despite the added challenge, freedom remains at the core:

- No forced progression systems
- No restrictive mechanics
- Build, explore, and survive at your own pace

## Who Is This For?

This modpack is ideal for players who want:

- A more challenging survival experience without hardcore punishment
- A stronger sense of immersion and exploration
- A vanilla-like experience, but deeper and more intense

## Development & Feedback

Mediumcore Vanilla+ is still **actively in development**, and the experience will continue to evolve over time.

### Planned additions include:

- Custom advancements to help players better understand certain mechanics and items
- Additional tweaks to improve balance, immersion, and overall gameplay

Your feedback is extremely valuable in shaping the future of the modpack.

If you have:

- Suggestions for new features
- Ideas to improve existing mechanics
- Feedback on balance or difficulty

**Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts! Every contribution helps make the modpack better.**
